hints.content:
Start by collecting the significands and exponents.

 $ \large{\dfrac {\blue{7.80} \times \pink{10^{7}}} {\blue{1.0} \times \pink{10^{4}}} = \blue{\dfrac{7.80}{1.0}} \times \pink{\dfrac{10^{7}}{10^{4}}}} $

Then divide each term separately. When dividing exponents with the same base, subtract their powers.

 $= \blue{7.80} \times \pink{10^{7 \,-\, 4}}$

 $= \blue{7.80} \times \pink{10^{3}}$
